summary: Defines a YANG module for configuring named collections of trusted certificates and trusted public keys. Other data models can refer to these collections when they need to decide whom to trust. The module can also send notifications when certificates are about to expire.

eli5.summary: Imagine a box where a device keeps a list of people it trusts, with their ID cards. This lets other settings point to that box, and it warns you when an ID card is nearly out of date.

questions: how to configure a truststore with netconf
